title: Computed Compensation, 20x AI Companion, Engagement Insights via MCP, and much more…
summary: This month, Humaans launched more ways to put your people data to work- Computed Compensation, 20x AI Companion, Engagement Insights via MCP...
body_markdown:
This month, we've launched more ways to put your people data to work. Compensation can now be built once, as a formula, and keeps itself up-to-date even as the numbers behind it change. AI Companion's got 20 times more powerful too, turning that same data into even sharper, deeper answers, and your Engagement Survey results are just a question away, inside AI Companion or via MCP. Read on.


**Automating compensation calculations**


You can now use formulas to calculate compensation directly in Humaans, saving your team time and reducing the risk of manual errors.


- **Flexible formulas:** Calculate monthly pay, bonuses and more from existing pay data and custom fields for eligible employees.
- **Shared inputs:** Re-use values such as salary uplift percentages or conversion rates across formulas to keep calculations consistent.
- **Automatic updates:** When a salary or another input changes, Humaans recalculates the compensation for you, saving you from updating manually.


**A more powerful AI Companion**


AI Companion now turns your people data into sharper answers, faster, and gives you full visibility into how that's being used across your organisation.


- **A more powerful model** : AI Companion now runs on a newer, more capable AI model that gives more natural answers and responds to simple questions more quickly.
- **AI usage** : see how much of your AI credit allowance you've used, all in one place.
- **Credits and billing** : every company gets a free monthly allowance for AI Companion, and you can top up on demand.
- **Centralised settings** : a new AI page under Settings lets owners and admins choose exactly which AI features are switched on for their organisation.


**Ask AI Companion about your engagement results**


Your Engagement Survey data now works for you the moment you ask a question, instead of sitting in a dashboard waiting to be dug through.


- **Query results directly** : ask AI Companion, or any MCP-connected assistant, about your engagement scores, trends or comments, and get a live answer.
- **Same permissions** : results are scoped to whatever you're already able to see in Engagement reporting.


Ask a question, and turn engagement insight into action, instantly.


**Add open-ended questions to your Engagement Surveys**


Engagement Surveys can now include open-ended questions, so alongside a rating, so your people can tell you what's actually on their mind.


- **Open-ended questions** : add a custom question, switch its response type from Scale to Text, and ask something like "What's one thing we could do better?" to collect written answers.
- **Scores stay untouched** : written answers sit alongside your rated questions without affecting your engagement or driver scores, and count towards required questions like any other.
- **Same confidentiality** : written answers follow the same anonymity rules as the rest of your survey, so people can speak candidly, and they're included in the AI summaries of what people are saying.


Now go deeper, learn what's really driving engagement, and turn it into further, even more meaningful improvements.


**Other improvements**


- **More customisation for Spaces:** Each Space can now use its own name and logo in welcome, invite and other platform emails, giving subsidiaries and affiliates their own branding.
- **Refreshed public API docs:** Our[public API docs](https://docs.humaans.io/api) have a new look, with clearer navigation, dark mode and easier-to-follow examples.
- **API token management:** Set expiry dates and rotate tokens with a 7-day grace period to keep integrations running.
- **Task filters:** Filter My Tasks and Team Tasks by type or workflow, and Team Tasks by assignee.
